title: Scout Motors hits 212,000 EV reservations amid $2B plant completion
digest: Scout Motors announced its South Carolina $2 billion plant is 85% complete with 212,000 EV reservations, including 87% hybrid EREVs and 75% SUV orders. CEO Scott Keogh said he expects reservations to roughly double before production starts but emphasized converting interest into sales as the priority. The company plans to launch mid-tier priced models first, using hybrid options as a transitional strategy to avoid pricing issues that delayed Rivian's deliveries. Reservations don't guarantee sales, as seen with Ford F-150 Lightning and Tesla Cybertruck pre-orders that didn't materialize into significant purchases. Keogh also clarified Scout's vehicles will offer both all-electric and extended-range EREV configurations with backup engines for battery power.

representative.title: Scout Motors新工厂建设完成度达85% 电动皮卡及SUV预订量突破21.2万
representative.summary: Scout Motors宣布其南卡罗来纳州2亿美元新工厂建设进入最终阶段，目前电动皮卡Terra和SUV Traveler预订量达21.2万份。CEO Keogh透露87%预订为混合动力版（EREV），75%为SUV车型，计划先推出中端价格车型以快速突破10万辆订单。对比Rivian因定价过高导致交付延迟的教训，Scout将混合动力选项作为过渡策略。
